body.heading: About this sheet
paragraphs: Free SparkKindly Kids kindness & feelings printable: Kindness Journal 02.
A gentle page about feelings and kind acts — draw, write and think about what makes people feel happy, and what you can do about it.

body.heading: How to use it
paragraphs: Print the sheet and take it slowly. There are no right answers on a feelings page — honest ones are the whole point.

takeaway: Naming feelings — your own and other people's — is the first step to handling them kindly.
materials: Crayons or pencils for drawing feelings
supervision: Listen more than you talk on this one — feelings pages often start the conversations children most need.
safetyNotes: Keep finished feelings pages private unless the child chooses to share them — feelings work deserves trust.
Print at 100% size (not "fit to page") so the sheet keeps its true size and the pictures stay the size they were drawn.
screenFreeExtension: Do the kind act from the page today — for real, before bed — and notice what happens.
